note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The Facebook Page, its posts, comments and ids are invented too.
how_it_was_run: Built by a script from invented responses to the same read calls the InsightfulPipe MCP makes; no write action was run.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "facebook-page-analyst" skill. Give me last month's report for my Facebook Page and tell me the three things to do next.

defaults_used.report: monthly page report with all eight modules
defaults_used.goal: reach (not given), so posts are ranked by views

data_pulled: get_page_insights, period days_28, viewers at each month end (1 call)
get_page_insights, page_follows_country and page_follows_city, last 7 days (1 call, 6 countries and 6 cities)
get_posts, last 365 days (87 posts: 83 content, 1 test, 3 profile or cover changes) (1 call)
get_post_insights for the 50 most recent content posts (50 calls)
get_comments for 40 posts: the 34 content posts in the 90 days and 6 older ones with comments (40 calls)
call_budget_note: 95 calls in all, over 60, so the count was given to the user before the run, paced at one call every 2 seconds.
